title.narrative: Country Programme for inclusive and sustainable industrial development in Albania 2020-2024

description.narrative: The Country Programme (CP) for inclusive and sustainable industrial development in Albania 2020-2024 is a guiding framework for UNIDO#s interventions in the country. It was signed on 13 March 2020 at the UNIDO headquarters in Vienna. Following the CP signing, UNIDO initiated an inception phase in 2020 aimed at the identification of priorities for the upcoming years and the development of particular project proposals. In parallel, an extensive promotional and fundraising campaign, involving diverse stakeholders, partners and donors was initiated. The CP high-level launch event, initially planned to take place in Tirana after the CP signing was cancelled due to the travel restrictions associated with the COVID-19 crisis. Instead, a series of bilateral meetings with development partners and potential donors facilitated by the Office of the Prime Minister of Albania # the leading Government counterpart # has been carried out to raise awareness about the CP and its objectives, explore avenues for strengthened cooperation, as well as present project proposals under the CP while creating synergies with potential partners and promoting a coherent joint approach.
